name: Maya Angelou
bio: Maya Angelou was an American poet, memoirist, and civil rights activist. She is best known for her series of seven autobiographies, starting with I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings (1969), which was nominated for a National Book Award and became a modern classic. Her poetry, collected in works like And Still I Rise, explores identity, family, and racism with lyrical strength and moral courage.
